Callout.Name: Theft from a Charity Shop
Callout.Message: Someone has taken the collection tin from a charity shop.
Callout.Advisory: Staff upset, description of one female.

Script.Line: I put money in that tin. I did not take money out of it.
It was on the counter and nobody was watching it.
I have a receipt from the shop next door. Look at the time on it.

Lines.Approach: Somebody took the tin off the counter. The staff are more upset than they are angry.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
